trigger.description: World Money 150+ country rollout and Local Stablecoin support exposed a previously untracked Ripio wFIAT family in the SOG corpus.
trigger.treatment: Discovery signal only. Promotion decisions use first-party World and Ripio sources.

assets.name: wARS
assets.priority_reason: World Money has a first-party Argentina ARS→wARS virtual-account route; Ripio publishes individual reserve attestations and current DeFi/product evidence.

assets.name: wCOP
assets.priority_reason: World Money has a first-party Colombia COP→wCOP virtual-account route; Ripio publishes an individual reserve attestation.

assets.name: wBRL
assets.priority_reason: Ripio identifies the asset as live, 1:1 backed, multi-network and individually attested; no World Money jurisdiction-specific route was established in this review.

assets.name: wMXN
assets.priority_reason: Ripio identifies the asset as live and 1:1 backed; World Money's current Mexico virtual account maps MXN to WLD, not wMXN.

assets.name: wCLP
assets.priority_reason: Ripio identifies the asset as live and 1:1 backed; asset-specific assurance and redemption detail still require full record review.

assets.name: wPEN
assets.priority_reason: Ripio identifies the asset as live and 1:1 backed; asset-specific assurance and redemption detail still require full record review.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: Introducing World Money: a financial super app for humans
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Does not establish every asset/function in every country.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: What is a Virtual Account?
supports: bank withdrawal path for Ripio virtual accounts
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Provider/product scope only; does not establish universal country-wide access.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: What is a Local Stablecoin?
supports: supported local stablecoins can be held/transacted
bank-transfer purchase requires matching fiat currency
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: The page does not enumerate every supported Local Stablecoin in every jurisdiction.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: Ripio stablecoins and infrastructure
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Family-level product evidence; individual asset assurance and legal/redemption fields still require asset review.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: wFIAT / Local Stablecoins
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Attestation coverage visible in the reviewed page is strongest for wARS, wBRL and wCOP.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: Ripio's wFIAT Stablecoins Go Live on Arc Public Mainnet From Day One
supports: all six wFIAT identities live on Arc
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Arc launch does not by itself establish issuer redemption terms or each asset's full historical network set.

reviewed_primary_sources.title: wARS lending markets are now available on Morpho, curated by KPK
reviewed_primary_sources.boundary: Yield/lending evidence is not issuer redemption or reserve evidence.

identity_and_duplicate_review.current_code_search_result: No canonical SOG records found for wARS, wBRL, wCOP, wMXN, wCLP, wPEN, wFIAT or Ripio at review entry.
identity_and_duplicate_review.reason: Each member has a different fiat reference currency and token identity; they must not be collapsed into one wFIAT canonical asset.

proposed_growth_sequence.policy_limit: Maximum two new canonical stable assets per growth PR.
proposed_growth_sequence.first_pair_reason: Both have direct World Money jurisdiction-specific virtual-account routes plus Ripio issuer/family evidence; both also have individual attestation evidence on Ripio's reviewed wFIAT page.
proposed_growth_sequence.later_pair_boundary: Order is provisional and must be re-reviewed against primary issuer, reserve, deployment, legal and redemption evidence immediately before promotion.

next_step: Build a complete-record review for wARS and wCOP. Promote only if identity, issuer/operator, backing/reserve disclosure, deployment, redemption/access, evidence, known-unknown and legal-profile requirements are satisfied on current sources.
